fields.label: Backup Plan ID
fields.help: The ID of the backup plan

fields.label: Backup Vault
fields.help: Backup vault where the backups gets stored using this Backup plan.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: The description allows for additional details about 'BackupPlan' and its use cases to be provided.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location for the backup plan

fields.label: Log Retention Days
fields.help: This is only applicable for CloudSql resource.

fields.label: Max Custom On Demand Retention Days
fields.help: The maximum number of days for which an on-demand backup taken with custom retention can be retained.

fields.label: Resource Type
fields.help: The resource type to which the 'BackupPlan' will be applied.

fields.label: Backup Rules
Backup Retention Days
fields.help: Configures the duration for which backup data will be kept.

fields.label: Rule ID
fields.help: The unique ID of this 'BackupRule'.

fields.label: Standard Schedule
Days Of Week
fields.help: Specifies days of week like MONDAY or TUESDAY, on which jobs will run.

fields.label: Hourly Frequency
fields.help: Specifies frequency for hourly backups.

fields.label: Months
fields.help: Specifies values of months Possible values: ["MONTH_UNSPECIFIED", "JANUARY", "FEBRUARY", "MARCH", "APRIL", "MAY", "JUNE", "JULY", "AUGUST", "SEPTEMBER", "OCTOBER", "NOVEMBER", "DECEMBER"]

fields.label: Recurrence Type
fields.help: RecurrenceType enumerates the applicable periodicity for the schedule.

fields.label: Time Zone
fields.help: The time zone to be used when interpreting the schedule.

fields.label: Backup Window
End Hour Of Day
fields.help: The hour of the day (1-24) when the window ends, for example, if the value of end hour of the day is 10, that means the backup window end time is 10:00.

fields.label: Start Hour Of Day
fields.help: The hour of the day (0-23) when the window starts, for example, if the value of the start hour of the day is 6, that means the backup window starts at 6:00.
A BackupWindow defines the window of the day during which backup jobs will run.

fields.label: Week Day Of Month
Day Of Week
fields.help: Specifies the day of the week.

fields.label: Week Of Month
fields.help: WeekOfMonth enumerates possible weeks in the month, e.g.
Specifies a week day of the month like FIRST SUNDAY or LAST MONDAY, on which jobs will run.
StandardSchedule defines a schedule that runs within the confines of a defined window of days.
The backup rules for this 'BackupPlan'.

fields.label: Compute Instance Backup Plan Properties
Guest Flush
fields.help: Indicates whether to perform a guest flush operation before taking a compute instance backup.
Defines optional compute instance related properties for backups generated by this plan.

fields.label: Disk Backup Plan Properties
Guest Flush
fields.help: Indicates whether to perform a guest flush operation before taking a disk backup.
Defines optional disk related properties for backups generated by this plan.
